source_note: Representative bounded records derived from Worldshepherd project working documents; they are test/intake fixtures, not maturity upgrades.

records.model_scope: Programmable deposited aluminum meta-alloy platform concept and validation pathway
assumptions: Property and production claims require modeling and coupon validation
Partner interest is a commercialization milestone, not technical proof
failure_modes: composition/process window does not produce target microstructure
coupon properties fail to exceed selected baseline
process variability prevents repeatable zoning or deposition
hazard_controls: No manufacturing parameter is treated as qualified until coupon evidence exists
records.external_safe_statement: WS-AlTi M1-MSZ-Prime is presently an IP-stage programmable deposited aluminum meta-alloy platform concept; no coupon-validated property or production-performance claim is made by this record.

records.model_scope: Reconfigurable electromagnetic tiles using phase/amplitude/material tuning for bounded field shaping

governing_equations.name: complex tile response
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: phasor representation of a bounded harmonic electromagnetic tile state

governing_equations.expression: E(r) = sum_i A_i exp(j theta_i) G_i(r)
governing_equations.name: array field superposition
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: linear superposition model for a specified operating band and tile response

governing_equations.expression: rho c_p dT/dt = div(k grad(T)) + Q
governing_equations.name: thermal balance
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: continuum heat-transfer model with specified material properties and heat source

assumptions: Positive and negative coupling describe constructive/destructive field shaping rather than exotic force generation
Prime-indexed modes, when used, are a mathematical decomposition basis and not evidence of quantum behavior
Physical admissibility requires finite energy, bounded coupling, stable thermal response, and convergent state evolution
boundary_conditions: Operating band, geometry, material state, and incident-field conditions must be specified before simulation
failure_modes: mutual coupling invalidates simplified tile independence
loss and dispersion prevent target phase/amplitude state
sensor or calibration error produces false null/beam estimate
hazard_controls: No stealth, cloaking, cancellation, or RF-performance claim without measured hardware evidence
records.external_safe_statement: This record describes a concept-stage programmable electromagnetic boundary-condition architecture using established field, thermal, and control models; no measured Worldshepherd-specific RF, stealth, cloaking, or cancellation performance is claimed.

records.model_scope: Worldshepherd-specific gridded-ion or related electrostatic propulsion article validation pathway

governing_equations.name: specific impulse
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: conventional propellant-expelling propulsion with a declared mass-flow system boundary

governing_equations.name: thrust-to-power ratio
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: declared electrical power boundary and calibrated thrust measurement

assumptions: Ion propulsion is externally established, but Worldshepherd-specific performance does not inherit external thruster values
Direct calibrated thrust, mass flow, power, facility background, and uncertainty are required for Worldshepherd-specific performance claims
Facility SOPs govern high-voltage, vacuum, plasma, RF, thermal, and propellant hazards
boundary_conditions: Any future simulation or test must declare article geometry, propellant, power boundary, facility pressure, and thrust-stand configuration
failure_modes: thrust signal is not separable from stand drift or facility effects
electrical or propellant measurement boundaries are incomplete
repeatability fails across independently prepared sessions
derived performance exceeds the evidence-supported operating envelope
hazard_controls: No powered thruster experiment is authorized by this record; approved facility SOP and hazard review are required
records.external_safe_statement: Ion propulsion is an established propulsion class; no Worldshepherd-specific ion-thruster thrust, efficiency, specific impulse, lifetime, or flight performance is claimed by this record.

records.model_scope: Falsification-first validation pathway for any Worldshepherd anomalous-force interpretation that would require momentum exchange beyond the quantitatively closed conventional system boundary

governing_equations.name: ideal one-way photon-force baseline
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: directed electromagnetic radiation carrying momentum away from the system

governing_equations.name: photon-force ratio
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: diagnostic comparison only; values above unity do not establish anomalous propulsion

assumptions: Balance deflection alone is not a propulsion measurement
Thermal, magnetic, electrostatic, gas-flow, RF/photon, cable/feedthrough, center-of-mass, vibration, and calibration effects must be quantitatively bounded
Published high-accuracy EMDrive null testing is a minimum control baseline for cavity-type anomalous-force experiments, not a universal proof about every conceivable future hypothesis
boundary_conditions: Any claimed residual must be defined only after all declared conventional momentum-transfer paths are included in the bookkeeping boundary
failure_modes: apparent force disappears under null or reversal control
signal tracks thermal or center-of-mass drift
magnetic, electrostatic, cable, gas, vibration, or RF leakage coupling is not bounded below the residual
effect fails independent setup or external replication
hazard_controls: No anomalous-force experiment is authorized by this record; facility-specific RF, high-voltage, vacuum, thermal, stored-energy, and mechanical controls are required
records.external_safe_statement: Worldshepherd anomalous-force and electrogravitic interpretations remain hypotheses. No reactionless, propellantless, gravity-control, or beyond-standard-model propulsion effect is currently claimed as experimentally established.
